beneficiary: A learner comparing exact decimal intent with JavaScript Number conversion and arithmetic, and distinguishing per-value representability from safe-integer guarantees.
preserved: All existing app, model, review, archive, deck validator/importer, authoring, workflow and other courses remain byte-identical. Importer #7 stays with its current owner.

explorer_contract.input: Two signed plain decimal strings, at most 18 whole and 18 fractional digits; no exponent notation, empty input, NaN or infinities. Leading/trailing whitespace is allowed; no expressions or evaluation.
explorer_contract.exact: Reduced BigInt rational arithmetic preserves each input's exact decimal value.
explorer_contract.number: Actual JavaScript Number conversion and addition/subtraction; DataView extracts each finite binary64 value exactly.
explorer_contract.decomposition: total signed discrepancy = combined operand-conversion contribution + operation-rounding contribution, all expressed as exact rational and finite decimal values.
explorer_contract.interpretation: A zero arithmetic contribution does not imply exact source conversion. Unsafe integer classification does not imply every particular integer is unrepresentable. Exact decimal text is an arithmetic reference, not a claim of measured truth.
explorer_contract.ui: Editable operands/operation, explicit calculate, named example presets, numeric comparison/error table, clear invalid-state refusal, keyboard focus and responsive wrapping, exact local worked-record download and optional lesson download.
explorer_contract.boundaries: Direct-open offline file with no packages, network calls or automatic persistence. No eval, input HTML insertion, arbitrary code, measurements, finance, assessment efficacy or importer adoption.

lesson_contract.content_review: Blind stem/options/transfer before answer key and explanations; independent native arithmetic/deck/review receiver; root separate actual offline browser receiving if an existing runtime meets resources.

native_guard.dependencies: Existing Node >=20 and Python; no new installs. Source may be prepared in memory before guard.

coordination: Root notified before edits; continuity accepted independent arithmetic/content receiving.
